Mr. Md. Abdul Awal, Advocate, For the petitioners. 
Mr. Bazlur Rashid, Advocate, For the opposite party.
parties:
Md. Delwar Hossain Molla alias Dilu Molla and others.
Vs.
Abul Kashem Molla being dead his heirs Md. Salim Molla and others.
full_judgment:
3. The plaintiff asserted in the plaint that 4.58 acres of land appertain to RS plot no. 2381, 8.47 acres of R.S plot no. 2386 under RS khatian no. 36 and 5.62 acres under plot no. 2418 and 5.18 acres under plot no. 2419 of RS khatian no. 47 of Londa Mouja were the subject matter of Title Suit No. 40 of 1954 of Subordinate Judge, Second Court, Barishal. 

 4. In the said suit (Title Suit No. 40 of 1954) the plaintiff Abul Kashem Molla was defendant no. 13 and his sister Mominjan was defendant no. 12. The said title suit was decreed on compromise on 23.04.1954 in preliminary form and the said decree was made final on 26.04.1954. The defendant nos. 12 and 13 (Mominjan and present plaintiff Abul Kashem Molla) of that suit got 2.86 acres of land from plot no. 2381 and 3.25 acres of land from plot no. 2386 of RS khatian No. 36 and 3.17 acres of land from plot no. 2418 and 2.85 acres of land from plot no. 2419 of RS khatian No. 47 in their saham, that is, in total defendant nos. 12 and 13 of the said suit got 12.13 acres of land in their share and pursuant to the said decree the defendant nos. 12 and 13 were possessing, the said land with the knowledge of all. 

 5. The plaintiff got 50% of the said decretal land measuring an area of 6.065 acres. The plaintiff has dwelling hut, pond and garden on plot no. 2386 of RS khatian No. 36. 

 34. Abul Kashem Molla as PW 1 deposed that Title Suit No. 40 of 1954 was filed in the Court of 2nd Subordinate Judge, Barishal for the land under RS khatian nos. 36 and 47 and in that suit he and his full sister Mominjan were the defendant nos. 12 and 13 and in that suit they got a decree on 23.04.1954 for 10.80 acres of land, the said decree was made final on 12.8.1955, his sister Mominjan Bibi died leaving him and the defendant nos. 1 and 2, he has been possessing 8.48 acres of land of which WAPDA has acquired .305 acres of land and deducting the said .305 acres of land he will get decree for 8.18 acres of land. 

 35. He also stated that it is not a fact that they got a decree in Title Suit No. 190 of 1956. He filed the certified copy of RS khatian nos. 36 and 47 marked as exhibits 1 and 1(Ka) and the decree of Title Suit No. 40 of 1954 marked as exhibits-2 series. He also stated that they have brought the record of Title Suit No. 40 of 1954 before the trial Court. 

 36. In cross examination, he stated that defendant no. 1 is his full brother, the defendant no. 1 is entitled to get a saham for 2.42 acres of land. In cross examination by defendant nos. 18-21 he stated that there were many owners in the said two khatians, he cannot say the names of all owners but can say the name of Sattya Ranjan and Vabo Ranjan, the predecessor of defendant nos. 18- 21 is his brother, he (predecessor of defendant nos. 18-21) is also entitled to get the share of his sister. He also stated that they are 3 brothers and 4 sisters. He categorically stated that he cannot say whether they, the 3(three) full brothers and sister Mominjan took the settlement of the land or not. He cannot say whether they filed the Title Suit No. 190 of 1956. He denied the defendants suggestion that they all the 3 brothers and sisters have been possessing the suit land. He also stated that his brothers have been possessing the land forcibly. 

 41. DW 3 Md. Delowar Hossain was examined on behalf of the defendant nos. 18-21 who deposed that he is defendant no. 18 and defendant nos. 19-21 is his sisters, 22.76 acres of land were recorded in RS khatian nos. 36 and 47, the said lands were in the schedule of Title Suit No. 40 of 1954 in the said suit his father Abdul Hamid and his uncle Hafiz were not made party, thereafter his father and uncles jointly filed Title Suit No. 190 of 1956, the said suit was decreed on compromise and pursuant to the decree of Title Suit No. 190 of 1956 their predecessors have been possessing the suit land now, they have been possessing the suit land and they have homestead on the suit land. He filed the plaint, petition of compromise and judgment and decree of Title Suit No. 190 of 1956 marked as exhibits 'Ka' series. He stated that it is not fact that the plaintiff has been possessing the suit land pursuant to the decree of Title Suit No. 40 of 1954.
